warning[ZBX-W0412]: some files have an owner or group that could not be mapped
  cause  the owners of 1 entries and the groups of 0 cannot be mapped in this
         user namespace; they are recorded as 65534. The first is
         '/src/etc/passwd'
  fix    chown them to an id the user can map, then import again
  more   zbx explain W0412 · rerun with --verbose for the full cause chain
